written: 2026-10-19, after the discovery search (group-A symbols, 2020-2023) and BEFORE looking at any holdout set
search_size: about 150,000 singles/pairs/triples over 3 frames x 2 directions -> expect strong decay out of sample
event: first touch of +5% (LONG) / -5% (SHORT) from the signal-bar close before the opposite 5%, up to the close of the next session
trade: first signal per symbol per day; entry at signal-bar close; +-5% bracket; exit at next-session close otherwise; 0.10% round-trip cost

combos.plain: stock up >20% over 20 days (as of yesterday) AND yesterday's daily range was the narrowest of 7 days (NR7) AND today a 15-min bar trades >2x its usual volume for that time of day
daily ATR% in the top 20% of its 120-day range (as of yesterday) AND today gapped down >5% AND a 30-min bar closes in the top 20% of its range
30-min MACD histogram crosses below zero AND that bar has >2x usual volume AND the stock is already down >3% vs yesterday's close

pass: net mean trade > 0 in B_disc, A_hold and B_hold, and day-clustered t >= 2 on the pooled holdout (A_hold+B_hold+B_disc); LARGE is an extra stress test
